title: Repository-Context-Guided Image Understanding for Agentic Software Development
abstract: arXiv:2611.13026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents increasingly receive UI screenshots as part of bug reports, yet degraded image quality - caused by low resolution, compression artifacts, or small rendered text - can prevent them from identifying the relevant UI elements and source files. Vision-language models become less reliable as image quality deteriorates, while OCR-assisted approaches may propagate recognition errors from degraded inputs. Both approaches are limited when the visual evidence required for localization is no longer clearly observable in the query screenshot. We propose augmenting coding agents with repository-rendered reference images: crisp screenshots generated from the same codebase that the agent is tasked with modifying. These references provide readable visual evidence of the application's UI while preserving the current, potentially bug-containing implementation state. translated_title: 面向智能体软件开发的仓库上下文引导图像理解
translated_abstract: 编程智能体越来越多地在错误报告中接收UI截图，然而图像质量的下降——由低分辨率、压缩伪影或过小的渲染文本引起——会阻碍它们识别相关的UI元素和源文件。随着图像质量恶化，视觉语言模型的可靠性降低，而OCR辅助方法则可能将识别错误从退化的输入中传播开来。当定位所需的视觉证据在查询截图中已不再清晰可见时，这两种方法都会受到限制。我们提出用仓库渲染的参考图像来增强编程智能体：即从智能体受命修改的同一代码库生成的清晰截图。这些参考图像在保留当前可能包含错误的实现状态的同时，提供了应用程序UI的可读视觉证据。由于它们是从现有仓库生成的，而无需依赖……
tldr: 提出通过从同一代码库渲染清晰的参考截图来增强编程智能体，从而在查询截图质量退化、视觉证据不清晰时，仍能准确识别UI元素并定位相关源文件。
en_tdlr: Proposes augmenting coding agents with crisp repository-rendered reference screenshots, enabling reliable identification of UI elements and localization of source files even when query screenshots are degraded and lack clear visual evidence.
